cited.quote: Commission shall make recommendations on improved reservation for Christians, Muslims and other Minorities

rationale: C4 (GO reconstituting the Backward Classes Commission) gives the Commission a term of reference on improved reservation for Muslims, but this is only the body that would report. No extract shows any action taken after a report on increasing backward Muslim reservation. C3 only restates the existing 3.5%.

cited.quote: The State Government bears the interest subsidy and interest subvention for crop loan
no interest is charged by the Co-operatives to the farmers who repay promptly

rationale: C4 and C2 report that during 2016-17 and 2017-18 the State bears the interest subsidy and farmers repaying on time pay no interest on crop loans. This matches the promise to continue full subsidy. No GO is shown, so the date is the policy note date of C4.

cited.quote: The Phase-I Extension of the Chennai Metro Rail Project is being implemented by Chennai Metro Rail Limited
accord administrative approval for transfer of land to the extent of 24 sq.m in Chennai District

rationale: C1 and C3 are GOs of 2016-12-29 transferring land to CMRL for the Phase-I Extension, with construction of the underground stretch started. These are official steps for a new route, but no extract shows the route operational.
None of the extracts concerns repayment of bank educational loans by the government. C1 and C2 cover self-employment loans and interest subsidies; C4 and C5 are tax and house-building advance orders.

cited.quote: bringing transparency and speeding up the trading process by introducing e-trading in 30 Regulated Markets
Trial runs on e-trading at Vellore and Perundurai Regulated Markets are under progress

rationale: C5 is the GO of 2019-10-21 sanctioning marketing infrastructure in 90 regulated markets and records e-trading in 30 of 282 regulated markets. C1 shows only pilot e-trading in 2017. Some regulated markets are covered, not all, so partial.

cited.quote: The free coaching classes are now conducted in colleges for competitive examinations through qualified resource persons

rationale: C1 reports Rs.50 lakh sanctioned and free coaching classes for poor students being conducted in colleges and universities. This matches the promise. No GO date is given, so the date is the policy note date of C1.

cited.quote: The EPC contract has been issued to M/s.Patel Engineering on 15.02.2018 for Package I & II of Phase I

rationale: C4 shows an EPC contract issued for the 500 MW Kundah pumped storage project, still under construction. C5 shows hydro capacity at only 2,321.90 MW overall, far from obtaining 2,500 MW of new hydro. An official step exists, but nothing is operational at the promised scale.

cited.quote: arrange to provide internship for a period of 25 days(one month) to 10000 students every year

rationale: C5 is a GO of 2020-12-22 sanctioning industry internships of 25 days, allowed only during vacation holidays, for 10,000 students of Government Engineering and Polytechnic Colleges. Only these college groups are covered, not students in colleges generally, so partial.

cited.quote: accord administrative approval and financial sanction for a sum of Rs.286 crore
The scheme will be implemented with 70% subsidy assistance subject to a maximum of Rs.56 lakh per boat

rationale: C5 is GO 115 dated 2017-05-23 giving administrative approval and financial sanction of Rs.286 crore for subsidised deep sea fishing boats. C2 gives the 70% subsidy per boat. This is a subsidy to buy mechanised fishing boats.

The promise and indicator do not name the project, and the extracts concern unrelated subjects (Mekedatu litigation, Chennai Metro cost, ROB works, a Tambaram bypass). No extract can be tied to the commitment.

The promise does not name the project, so no extract can be identified as about it. The extracts cover town panchayat funds, desilting works, irrigation and a Pollachi road DPR, none tied to the commitment.

cited.quote: To train, retrain and upgrade the weavers' skill, multi-level training in weaving, design development and processing

rationale: C4 is G.O. Ms. No. 41 of 2019-03-04 implementing the new Integrated Textile Policy, whose handloom section provides weaver skill training and a Handloom Support Programme. This is a dedicated new measure on weaver productivity.

cited.quote: increase of Rebate Subsidy Scheme allocation for co-operative sector from Rs.80 crore to Rs.150 crore per year

rationale: C5 is G.O. Ms. No. 41 of 2019-03-04, which orders welfare and income measures for handloom weavers, including a higher rebate subsidy allocation and higher interest subsidy. This is a new official measure to raise weaver incomes.

cited.quote: Development of Mobile Application for Citizen Centric Services - Administrative sanction accorded
Utilization of mobile telephone in delivery of services would be encouraged in all Departments
It is a Mobile platform where citizens can access all the Government services

rationale: C1 (GO of 2017-03-08) sanctions a mobile application for 25 citizen services. C3 is a policy that only encourages mobile delivery in all departments. C4 sanctions a single mobile app for departmental services. Mobile delivery is started but not extended to all services.

cited.quote: Development of Mobile Application for Citizen Centric Services - Administrative sanction accorded
all public services of each Government Department / Agency or body shall be delivered in electronic mode

rationale: The indicator is an IT department notification extending mobile services to all departments. C1 sanctions a mobile app for only 25 services. C2 and C5 concern electronic service delivery rules, not mobile. No extract shows a notification on mobile services for all departments.

cited.quote: 42 Community Health Centres have been identified at one per Health Unit District to function as Level-II MCHCs

rationale: C3 says 42 Community Health Centres were identified as Level-II Maternal and Child Health Centres and are being strengthened. This matches the number 42 but shows no GO and no 24-hour operation of those centres, so it is a preparatory step.

cited.quote: Works in Adyar and Coovum basins are divided into 39 packages. Works in 35 packages are in progress
Corporation has prepared a Detailed Project Report for Kosasthalaiyaru, Coovum, Adayar and Kovalam Basin

rationale: C2 and C3 show a detailed project report for integrated storm water drains in Greater Chennai basins, with World Bank funded works in progress and work orders issued. The works are not reported complete, so the drainage is not yet delivered.

cited.quote: accord Administrative Sanction for a sum of Rs.38.74 Crores (Rupees Thirty Eight crores and Seventy Four lakhs only)
Carrying out Land Acquisition for Construction of 4 Road Over Bridges in lieu of existing LC. Nos.4,5,137 and 141

rationale: C4 and C5 are GOs of 2018 sanctioning a road over bridge and land acquisition for four more road over bridges. C2 and C3 report continuing road widening and bridge works. This shows the road and bridge projects being continued. The date is the earliest GO shown.

cited.quote: Cloud Based Services such as Webhosting on a self- service mode for the benefit of emerging young entrepreneurs
Enhancement of Cloud Infrastructure and extension of Disaster Recovery facility to Cloud infrastructure

rationale: C1 describes cloud services for students and entrepreneurs, but its programme was launched on 01.03.2016, before the government took office, and was limited to 100 users. C4 sanctions cloud infrastructure for government use, not students or entrepreneurs. No qualifying expansion is shown.

cited.quote: Most of the existing thermal power stations of TANGEDCO have served more than 25 years

rationale: The extracts concern existing thermal stations, their load factors, pollution control and coal supply. None shows an official step or added capacity for new thermal stations towards 13,000 MW. C5 is a free electricity order on a different subject.
